issues.description: The problem statement asks students to implement a custom toString() that returns a String (and gives a String example). In the solution implementation, toString() is declared with return type Object (public Object toString()), which does not match the expected String return type and will not correctly override Object.toString(), causing a compilation/signature mismatch and confusion for students using the solution as reference.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the toString() declaration in the solution to return a String: declare it as public String toString() (keeping the @Override annotation) and ensure the method returns a String. This matches the problem description and corrects the signature so it properly overrides Object.toString().
